text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can produce art, music, and writing that look and sound surprisingly human. Some people worry that machines will replace artists and writers. However, AI does not truly feel or imagine; it learns from patterns in existing works. Human creativity comes from emotion, experience, and personal ideas, which machines cannot copy. Instead of seeing AI as a rival, we can use it as a helpful tool. Artists and writers can work with AI to explore new styles and save time. In the end, the best results may come from humans and machines working together.
